Technology

TORAY PRIMEFLEX™

Unlike other performance fabrics, the Toray PrimeFlex has a unique spiral yarn that not only gives this fabric a built-in mechanical stretch for 360° flexibility, but it will stretch and recover without using heavier water-absorbing elastics like Spandex. It also boasts an outstanding amount of comfort, breathability, and abrasion-resistance at only 40% of the weight of the old-school stretchy stuff. Partially made from a corn-based material that uses less water during the manufacturing process, the Primeflex fabric is both environmentally conscious and technologically advanced—elevating your running experience from mile one to mile one hundred.

Size + Fit

The Graves PX Shell runs true to size. It's tailored but not slim. Built to fit over a tee. If you are layering with heavier mid layers, consider taking a size up.

Model #1 Theon - 6’1” with a muscular build, wearing size medium

weather protection that moves with you

Crafted from our signature Toray Primeflex ™ fabric found in our bestselling running shorts, the Graves PX Shell is lightweight, wind and water-resistant, and significantly more breathable than a rain taped-seam jacket. Your first line defense against the elements, it packs down into its own pocket for easy carry, and the modern, minimalist style easily transitions beyond the trail.
